## Change / 变更

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Note any changed data, ABI, or compatibility contract.

描述具体问题及修改后的行为，注明数据、ABI 或兼容性约定的变化。

## Validation / 验证

List the checks actually run and their results. For UI changes, include browser interactions and error-log inspection. For performance claims, include the measured environment and workload.

列出实际执行的检查及结果。UI 修改应包含浏览器交互和错误日志检查；性能结论应包含实测环境及负载。

- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese documentation were updated together, or this change does not affect documentation. / 英文和简体中文文档已同步更新，或本次改动不影响文档。
- [ ] Documentation structure checks passed, and paired text was reviewed for matching meaning. / 文档结构检查已通过，配对文本已核对语义一致性。

## Remaining scope / 剩余范围

State material limitations, unverified behavior, and any required follow-up.

说明重要限制、尚未验证的行为及必要的后续工作。
